[EN] Thulsa's Doom
[ES] La perdición de Thulsa
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the cave at the northern end, where the Valkyon Federation soldiers are preparing to launch an attack on the Ebon Tower. Then meet with Centurion Traveron and find out about the tower.
[ES] Ve a la cueva en el extremo norte, donde los soldados de la Valkyon Federation se preparan para lanzar un ataque a Ebon Tower. Luego, reúnete con el centurión Traveron y obtén información sobre la torre.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Enter the Ebon Tower.
[ES] Entra a Ebon Tower.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the Ebon Tower {@LinkCreature:251#1501#teleportal} with Killian's gem.
[ES] Ve a la Ebon Tower {@LinkCreature:251#1501#teleportal} con la gema de Killian.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the Ebon Tower teleportal with Killian's gem.
[ES] Ve al teletransporte de la Ebon Tower con la gema de Killian.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Enter the Ebon Tower and defeat {@LinkCreature:3009#2101#Maceris}. [You must select Ebon Tower (Solo) from the {@LinkCreature:251#1501#Teleportal} to advance this quest.]
[ES] Entra a la Ebon Tower y derrota a {@LinkCreature:3009#2101#Maceris}. [Debes seleccionar Ebon Tower (Solo) en el {@LinkCreature:251#1501#Teleportal} para avanzar en esta misión.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Intruders...shall...die...
[ES] Los intrusos... van a... morir...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Forgive me, Thulsa!
[ES] ¡Perdóname, Thulsa!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat {@LinkCreature:3009#5102#Kaersidar}.
[ES] Derrota a {@LinkCreature:3009#5102#Kaersidar}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat {@LinkCreature:3009#5101#Bloodstone}.
[ES] Derrota a {@LinkCreature:3009#5101#Bloodstone}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I'll grant you death...
[ES] Te concederé la muerte...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] This can't be...I should have the power!
[ES] ¡Esto no puede ser... Debería tener el poder!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the Altar of Death and defeat Thulsa.
[ES] Ve al Altar of Death y derrota a Thulsa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Inner Chamber of the Ebon Tower
[ES] Cámara interior de la Ebon Tower
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I think Thulsa escaped through the teleportal!
[ES] ¡Creo que Thulsa escapó a través del teletransporte!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go after Thulsa! He's escaping!
[ES] ¡Ve tras Thulsa! ¡Está escapando!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Chase after Thulsa.
[ES] Persigue a Thulsa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Investigate the Ebon Tower {@LinkCreature:251#1501#teleportal} in Vale of Spires to find traces of Thulsa.
[ES] Investiga el {@LinkCreature:251#1501#teleportal} de la Ebon Tower en Vale of Spires para encontrar rastros de Thulsa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
